name: custom__music_play
description: Play a playlist in Apple Music by name. Use when you want to hear music.

name: custom__music_next
description: Skip to the next track in Apple Music.

name: custom__music_now
description: Show what is currently playing in Apple Music.
command: osascript -e 'tell application "Music" to get name of current track & " by " & artist of current track'

name: custom__verse_of_the_day
description: Get a random verse from Proverbs. Use for daily wisdom, encouragement, or to start the day with scripture.

name: custom__calendar_events
description: Get calendar events from the Mac's Calendar app (Google + iCloud calendars included). range: today | tomorrow | week. Returns lines of 'Day date time | event | calendar | location'.

range.description: Window to fetch; omit for today
